reviews.title: DONT WALK, RUN NOW ! TRY IT !
reviews.text:
This has to be the best app created in the past decade. This app has literally changed my life. It offers sooooo much all in one. The creators are very attentive to details and ask for feedback very often to optimize the app. 
If you’re looking to start your fitness journey, this is the app for you. I wanted to start working out but had no idea where to start, was absolutely not comfortable in a gym setting and I came across this app. 
It’s very inclusive, whether you’re a gym head or prefer a home gym setting !! You can do both if you can rock it too ahah. 
It’s really an everything in 1.
Tracking your macros? It has it. 
Workout plans? It has it. 
Meal prep ideas? It has it. 
Healthy recipes? It has it. 
Supportive community? It has it. 
Supplements? It has it. 
The macro tracker is VERY accurate.
The AI options for recipes is awesome, the AI within the macro tracker is VERY accurate. 
There’s things for everybody, I have tried different coaches and programs until I found a coach that works best for me ! 
I cannot recommend this app enough ! 
REALLY RUN DOWNLOAD IT !!! 
Since my journey started I lost 50lbs and this is literally all thanks to Solin making it easy for me to focus on just doing the workouts, I don’t have to think or plan or figure out things. I just do !

reviews.title: Macro Tracker
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Solin’s macro tracker for about two months now. I joined a program on the Solin app, and the coach encourages folks to track macros. Other macro trackers were recommended but I didn’t want to login into a different app and when I signed up, this tracker was the only one that would enter food by voice.  I really didn’t want to track my food actually but it turns out I had a 58-day streak I think bc Solin made it easy with that voice feature in particular. I wanted to spend as little time as possible tracking— and this seems to work for me. Tracking has helped me learn how to better fuel my body.

Solin’s macro tracker can be a bit glitchy, and there aren’t many foods available for search yet but because I can enter so many things by voice and barcode just fine most of the time, it works out. Sometimes, if you scan a barcode, none of the data will be entered. Also, I find that if I take a picture of a plate of food without including the weight of the food, the calories and macros can be way too high. But overall, I’m happy I chose to track with Solin!
